prompt.content: What was the name by which Peter the Patrician was said to have been called in the Patria of Constantinople?

output: Peter the Patrician was known as **"Πέτρος τ' ἡμῶν Πατρικός"** (Petros t' hımôn Patrikios) in Byzantine Greek, meaning "Peter our Patrician." This was a title of respect and authority
